traditional: No classical doctrine: Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Mind meets power. Forceful, penetrating communication; words that can heal or wound and tend to be remembered. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of thinking and power is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Sales, persuasion, research, and anything requiring depth and force of message.
shadow: Scattered overthinking fused with control and obsession, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.body: One question can take a conversation much deeper once the polite explanation no longer accounts for what is happening. When Mercury conjoins Pluto, thought and power fuse, sharpening attention around hidden motives, missing information, and the part of the story with leverage behind it. Research and difficult conversations can become unusually productive under this aspect. The useful question is the one that changes the next decision, not the one that keeps an interrogation going after enough is already known.
